theme: Peak Yatra-week rides and loss-aversion - airport runs, valley drives and golden-hour shikaras booking all day; an idle cab or boat loses the fare to a listed one
season: Mid-summer (10 July 2026). The Amarnath Yatra is underway (3 Jul - 28 Aug), so Pahalgam, Sonamarg and Baltal are busy and the Srinagar-Pahalgam and Srinagar-Sonamarg roads run heavy; book early and start early. Srinagar is warm by day and cool at dawn (~15-30C), the gardens are in full bloom and the Dal is calm under clear skies at first light; the high meadows and Gulmarg are lush and green with the gondola running, while the plains sit above 40C. Valley travel runs roughly 7am-6pm during the Yatra; brief afternoon showers possible.
